name: LaneCode
summary: Lane identifier — renders as `LAX → SFO` with a proper arrow glyph (→ U+2192, not -> ascii) and mono-numerics. Optional inline rate (e.g. '$262'). Compact horizontal pill with hairline border. Use everywhere a freight lane is referenced.

rules: Visible focus ring required (outline + box-shadow per AGENTS.md hard rule 11).
Color is never the only signal — pair with label, shape, or icon.

dont: NEVER use ASCII '->' for the arrow — use U+2192 ('→').
NEVER use Title Case for codes (always uppercase).
NEVER nest a LaneCode inside another LaneCode.
